stem.en: Match each stall activity to the element of entrepreneurship it shows. This is one example.

text.en: Splitting the work: some squeeze lemons, others take the money
Watching which drinks parents and children ask for on a hot day
Adding mint leaves to make a new kind of nimbu pani
Aiming to make a profit in the Young Entrepreneurs Challenge

explanation.en: Classmates sharing the work are the team. The visitors and what they want are the market. A new recipe is innovation. Making a profit in the challenge is the goal.

hints.en: Which part is about the people who work at the stall, and which is about the people who buy?
